primary_estimand: Effect of 12 weeks voluntary wheel running vs age-matched sedentary on brain gene expression, analysed separately per tissue (cortex, hippocampus) and per age cohort (young 1-2 mo start; midlife 12 mo start, runners split into high/low by >10,000 rotations/night)
planned_contrasts: cortex young Run vs Sed (S2.2.p1: 1252 DE; 742 up, 510 down)
cortex midlife RunHi vs Sed (S2.2.p1: 214; 70 up, 144 down)
cortex midlife RunLow vs Sed (S2.2.p1: 67; 20 up, 47 down)
hippocampus young Run vs Sed (S2.2.p1: 2026; 1498 up, 528 down)
hippocampus midlife RunHi vs Sed (S2.2.p1: 271; 87 up, 184 down)
hippocampus midlife RunLow vs Sed (S2.2.p1: 172; 80 up, 92 down)
paper_method: RSEM counts; edgeR 3.20.9, filter CPM>=1 in >1 sample, TMM, quasi-likelihood F-test, per tissue (S5.6.p1)
inclusion: male C57BL/6J; young n=5 per activity for RNA-seq (S5.2.p1); midlife n=12 run (6 high, 6 low) + 12 sed (S2.1.p1, S5.2.p1); young and midlife not directly compared (run at separate times, S5.6.p1)
paper_results: DEG counts per contrast in S2.2.p1 / Fig 3b,g; named genes S2.3.p1, S2.4.p2
